annotations.title: Find stations, sights and events near a point

description: Stations, sights and this week's events within walking distance of a place or a coordinate in Japan, nearest first, with estimated walking minutes. Give either place (a place ID) or lat and lng. Coordinates are used only to compute distances and are not stored. Returns origin, stations[] (with walkMinutes), sights[] (with walkMinutes, description, fee, rainy-day and step-free notes, routeEndpoint), events[] (this week, within 5 km), page.

lang.description: Language of names and texts in the response. Long descriptions exist in Japanese and English only; other languages fall back to English.

lat.description: Latitude (WGS84), within Japan. Three decimal places are enough.

limit.description: Maximum number of sights (stations and events are capped at 5 each).

place.description: Place ID to search around (use this instead of lat/lng when the user names a station or spot).

name: find_nearby
title: Find stations, sights and events near a point
